$comment: Copy this file into the schnellerTyp-e config folder as rules/<name>.json
(Settings > Custom rules > Open config folder), then press Reload.
It becomes a new entry in the language selector and gets its own tray badge.
trigger        the keystrokes to match, at the end of the current word
caseSensitive  false (default) matches 'BTW' as well as 'btw'
smartCase      true (default) copies the typed casing onto the result:
wordStart      true fires only when the trigger is the whole word so far
The longest matching trigger wins. Pressing the trigger's last key again
undoes the substitution, and the escape key takes the next keystroke
